player_prompt.intro:
Akwaaba Frozen Lake!

Wo ne 'P' a ɛwɔ grid no so.
Grid symbols:
  ' ' = Frozen surface (faako a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ)
  'H' = Hole (sɛ wodɔ mu a, wobɛhwɛ anim!)
  'G' = Goal (sɛ woduru ha a, woadi nkonim!)
  'P' = Wo position a ɛteɛ

Actions a wotumi yɛ: up, down, left, right (anaa w, a, s, d)
To wo action no sɛ: [up], [down], [left], [right] anaa [w], [a], [s], [d]

Botae: Fa wo ho fi aseɛ (soro-konɔ) kɔ goal no so (aseɛ-nifa) a, wɔnngɔ hole mu!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nkɔso no mu yɛ biribi. Fa [up], [down], [left], [right] anaa [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Adwuma a wonnim no '{action}'. Fa di dwuma, soro, fam, benkum, nifa anaa w, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: Woyɛɛ sɛ wobɛsesa {action} nanso wokuraa ɔfasu mu!

outcome.win: Anigye! Woadi botae no ho dwuma.
outcome.fell_in_hole: Woahwehwe abura mu! Agoro. Wode {pct}% akwantu no awie kɔkɔɔkɔ wɔ ɔfasuo a wɔde si aniwa so hɔ.
outcome.turn_limit: Woadu ɛdan no ano! Agoro. Wode {pct}% awie akwantu akɔ botae no ho.
